lines.zh: 我踩着草原的碎石，长尾划出弧线。
lines.en: I pick across the plain, my long tail drawing a curve.

lines.zh: 细长的腿一步半丈，尘土跟在脚后。
lines.en: My slim legs eat the ground, dust trailing behind.

lines.zh: 三重脚趾落地很轻，草叶也不折。
lines.en: Three-toed feet land so lightly the grass stays unbent.

lines.zh: 我沿着溪边小路往东跑，风在肋骨间穿。
lines.en: I run the creek path east; wind threads my ribs.

lines.zh: 低矮的蕨丛正好藏住我的脊背。
lines.en: The low ferns hide my spine just right.

lines.zh: 前面开阔，我先跑一段再说。
lines.en: Open ground ahead — I'll run a stretch of it.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，转弯不用减速。
lines.en: One swing of the tail and I turn without slowing.

lines.zh: 我绕过那块巨石，石缝里有虫鸣。
lines.en: I skirt the boulder; insects chirr in the cracks.

lines.zh: 小跑时我总爱把脖子探得很前。
lines.en: At a trot I always push my neck far forward.

lines.zh: 影子短短地贴着脚边，正是正午。
lines.en: My shadow hugs my feet — it must be noon.

lines.zh: 我踮着脚穿过沙地，爪印一串。
lines.en: I tiptoe over the sand, leaving a string of prints.

lines.zh: 这片平原空得很，我要多走几圈。
lines.en: This plain is empty; I'll circle it a few more times.

lines.zh: 轻骨头的身体跑起来像风一样快。
lines.en: Hollow bones make me quick as wind.

lines.zh: 我沿着兽径，鼻子几乎贴地。
lines.en: I follow the game trail, nose almost to the dirt.

lines.zh: 草穗扫过肚腹，有点痒。
lines.en: Seed heads brush my belly and tickle.

lines.zh: 我折回那棵歪树，那里能看得远。
lines.en: I turn back to the leaning tree — better view there.

lines.zh: 步子放慢，让爪子歇一歇。
lines.en: I slow the pace to let my claws rest.

lines.zh: 从蕨丛到溪口，我认得每一步。
lines.en: From ferns to creek mouth, I know every step.

lines.zh: 我歪头听着草里的动静。
lines.en: I tilt my head toward a rustle in the grass.

lines.zh: 站着时我靠长尾撑住重心。
lines.en: Standing, my long tail keeps me balanced.

lines.zh: 风把我的气味吹向远处。
lines.en: The wind carries my scent far off.

lines.zh: 我盯着一只蜥蜴，暂时不饿。
lines.en: I watch a lizard; I'm not hungry yet.

lines.zh: 脖子抬高一点，好看看四周。
lines.en: Neck up a little, the better to see around.

lines.zh: 阳光暖在背上，我眯了眼。
lines.en: Sun warms my back and my eyes narrow.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖细鳞，落下一粒沙。
lines.en: I shake my fine scales and a grain of sand falls.

lines.zh: 这地方很静，只有虫子在叫。
lines.en: It's quiet here but for the insects.

lines.zh: 我在原地换了个方向，风变了。
lines.en: I turn in place; the wind has shifted.

lines.zh: 爪尖在土里刻了半圈。
lines.en: A claw scores half a circle in the dirt.

lines.zh: 我不用站着，可我也没想走。
lines.en: I needn't stand here, yet I don't feel like leaving.

lines.zh: 不远处有骨头，气味很旧了。
lines.en: There's a bone nearby; its smell is old.

lines.zh: 我眨眨眼，把尘土眨出去。
lines.en: I blink the dust away.

lines.zh: 有人类走过，我先看看再说。
lines.en: Something walked by; I'll just watch first.

lines.zh: 轻风把蕨叶压平又放开。
lines.en: A light breeze flattens the ferns and lets them rise.

lines.zh: 我低头理了理胸前的羽毛。
lines.en: I dip my head and preen the down on my chest.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，我拉直了脖子。
lines.en: You're too close; I crane my neck.

lines.zh: 我打量你，先看你手里有没有东西。
lines.en: I size you up, starting with your hands.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我脚边，我退了半步。
lines.en: Your shadow touches my feet; I step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 我把头一侧，让你猜不透我在想什么。
lines.en: I cock my head to keep you guessing.

lines.zh: 若你退开，我也许会回来看你。
lines.en: Step back and I might come look at you again.

lines.zh: 我盯住你的眼，一直不肯眨。
lines.en: I fix on your eyes and refuse to blink.

lines.zh: 你太高了，我得仰着头。
lines.en: You're too tall; I have to look up.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里有一声轻轻的咕哝。
lines.en: A soft grumble rises in my throat.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻你的靴子，气味陌生。
lines.en: I sniff your boots; the smell is strange.

lines.zh: 我不躲你，可别伸手摸我。
lines.en: I won't shy away from you, but keep your hands off me.

lines.zh: 我把长尾往你那边挪了挪，是警告。
lines.en: My tail drifts toward you — that's a warning.

lines.zh: 你看够了没有？我要走了。
lines.en: Seen enough? I'm leaving.

lines.zh: 我痛得弓起身子，尾巴甩乱。
lines.en: Pain bends me double; my tail flails.

lines.zh: 挨这一下，我细腿差点折了。
lines.en: One blow like that nearly snaps my thin legs.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，声音尖了。
lines.en: My cry comes out high and thin.

lines.zh: 我退开几步，回头看伤痕。
lines.en: I back off a few steps and look at the wound.

lines.zh: 血在细鳞间渗出来。
lines.en: Blood seeps between my fine scales.

lines.zh: 我喘得很快，肋骨起伏。
lines.en: I pant fast, ribs heaving.

lines.zh: 腿在抖，我还想站着。
lines.en: My legs shake; I still want to stand.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，护住脖颈。
lines.en: I lower my head to guard my neck.

lines.zh: 疼让我忘了我本来要去哪。
lines.en: The pain makes me forget where I was going.

lines.zh: 我抽着气，躲进蕨丛。
lines.en: Hissing, I duck into the ferns.

lines.zh: 那块肉在你指缝里，我早闻见了。
lines.en: That meat between your fingers — I smelled it long ago.

lines.zh: 我的脚自己往前走了一步。
lines.en: My feet take a step without asking me.

lines.zh: 是血的气味，我骗不了自己。
lines.en: It's the smell of blood; I can't fool myself.

lines.zh: 你晃一晃，我脖子就跟着晃。
lines.en: Move it and my neck moves with it.

lines.zh: 我扭头看别处，眼角还挂着你。
lines.en: I look away, but the corner of my eye stays on you.

lines.zh: 这块肉换我一程跟随，行不行？
lines.en: That meat for a short escort — fair?

lines.zh: 我吞口水的声音，自己都嫌响。
lines.en: I gulp so loudly that I embarrass myself.

lines.zh: 举低些，我这脖子够不到。
lines.en: Lower it — this neck of mine can't reach that high.

lines.zh: 我先绕半圈，看看是不是陷阱。
lines.en: I circle halfway first — this could be a trap.

lines.zh: 你给我，我就离你近些。
lines.en: Give it here and I'll come nearer.

lines.zh: 我饿得尾巴都安静不下来。
lines.en: I'm so hungry my tail won't stay still.

lines.zh: 肉的味道盖过了草味。
lines.en: Meat drowns out the taste of green.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，再低头看手。
lines.en: I look at your face, then at your hand.

lines.zh: 再往前一步，我就咬。
lines.en: One more inch and I'll snap.

lines.zh: 我不叫，可我在等。
lines.en: I make no sound, but I'm waiting.

lines.zh: 这气味让我忘了害怕。
lines.en: This smell makes me forget caution.

lines.zh: 撞到我，我的长尾甩了过来。
lines.en: You bump me and my long tail whips round.

lines.zh: 我踉跄两步，细腿差点打结。
lines.en: I stumble twice, thin legs nearly tangling.

lines.zh: 别挤，我的骨头很轻。
lines.en: Easy — my bones are light.

lines.zh: 我一缩身，长尾从你腿边擦过。
lines.en: I tuck myself away and my long tail brushes past your legs.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我叫了一声。
lines.en: That bump earns a honk from me.

lines.zh: 我回头瞪你，头上的羽冠竖起。
lines.en: I glare back, the crest on my head lifting.

lines.zh: 我贴着草边绕开，不想撞上谁。
lines.en: I slide along the grass edge to avoid a crash.

lines.zh: 脚下的土被我们踢起一层。
lines.en: We kick up a layer of dust.

lines.zh: 我弹开半步，又回头看。
lines.en: I spring back a half step and glance over.

lines.zh: 轻身子的好处，撞一下也不倒。
lines.en: Being light pays off — a knock won't fell me.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴碰它的尾巴，慢慢绕圈。
lines.en: I touch tails with it and slowly circle.

lines.zh: 它叫一声，我就回一声。
lines.en: It calls once; I answer once.

lines.zh: 我们并着肩走，谁也不抢前。
lines.en: We walk shoulder to shoulder, neither ahead.

lines.zh: 我用鼻尖蹭它的颈侧。
lines.en: I nuzzle the side of its neck.

lines.zh: 草窝已经压平，正好歇脚。
lines.en: The grass nest is flattened, ready to rest in.

lines.zh: 它的骨节和我一样轻。
lines.en: Its bones are as light as mine.

lines.zh: 我们在溪边一起低头喝水。
lines.en: We both dip our heads at the creek.

lines.zh: 它跑开，我追上半步就停。
lines.en: It darts off; I give chase half a step, then stop.

lines.zh: 这段日子，我们只用叫声说话。
lines.en: These days we speak only in calls.

lines.zh: 风一转，我们的味儿就混在一处。
lines.en: The wind turns, and our scents blend into one.

lines.zh: 我叼起那块肉，抬腿就跑。
lines.en: I snatch the meat and bolt.

lines.zh: 这骨头比我还长，我拖着走。
lines.en: This bone is longer than me; I drag it.

lines.zh: 我试着衔起羽毛，风一吹就掉了。
lines.en: I try to carry a feather, and the wind steals it.

lines.zh: 我用前爪按住它，怕被抢走。
lines.en: I pin it with a forefoot so none can steal it.

lines.zh: 太小了，我一口就吞了。
lines.en: Too small — I swallow it whole.

lines.zh: 我把它埋在蕨丛下，回头再吃。
lines.en: I bury it under the ferns for later.

lines.zh: 咬着东西时我走得很别扭。
lines.en: Carrying things makes my walk awkward.

lines.zh: 我低头嗅了嗅，确认能吃。
lines.en: I sniff it once to make sure it's food.

lines.zh: 你扔下的东西，我先守一会儿。
lines.en: What you dropped, I'll guard a while.

lines.zh: 嘴里叼不住两块，只能选一块。
lines.en: My jaws hold only one; I must choose.

lines.zh: 我闻到活物的血，盯住了。
lines.en: I catch the smell of something living and lock on.

lines.zh: 嗓子里的声音变了，我弓起背。
lines.en: My call changes pitch and my back arches.

lines.zh: 它动了，我的眼睛就跟过去。
lines.en: It moved, and my eyes follow.

lines.zh: 先伏低，再从蕨丛那边蹭过去。
lines.en: I crouch first, then slip over past the ferns.

lines.zh: 它跑得太快，我改从侧面绕。
lines.en: It's too quick, so I swing wide.

lines.zh: 这个能咬，那个咬不动。
lines.en: This one can be bitten; that one can't.

lines.zh: 我不叫了，安静地选好路线。
lines.en: I stop calling and pick my line quietly.

lines.zh: 汗味、血味，都指同一个方向。
lines.en: Sweat and blood point the same way.

lines.zh: 我压低尾巴，让脚不出声。
lines.en: I drop my tail so my feet stay silent.

lines.zh: 一步，又一步，我先要近些。
lines.en: One step, then another — first I need to be near.

lines.zh: 我贴着草丛跟，步子越放越轻。
lines.en: I trail through the grass, each step lighter.

lines.zh: 它还回头，我就立刻不动。
lines.en: It looks back; I freeze at once.

lines.zh: 距离在缩，我的呼吸变浅。
lines.en: The gap shrinks and my breath goes shallow.

lines.zh: 我从石堆绕到它背后。
lines.en: I slip around the rocks to its far side.

lines.zh: 太远了，我得再快些。
lines.en: Too far — I need more speed.

lines.zh: 前面有坡，正好借力。
lines.en: A slope ahead; good ground to spring from.

lines.zh: 我一直盯着它的脚，不看别处。
lines.en: I watch its feet and nothing else.

lines.zh: 它转向，我的尾巴先动。
lines.en: It turns, and my tail moves first.

lines.zh: 我把身子压得更低。
lines.en: I press myself lower still.

lines.zh: 快了，等它踩进蕨丛。
lines.en: Almost — wait until it steps into the ferns.

lines.zh: 我跳起一咬，牙齿落在它后腿。
lines.en: I leap and bite down on its hind leg.

lines.zh: 爪子先蹬地，再扑出去。
lines.en: My claws push off the dirt and I spring.

lines.zh: 我甩头撕扯，不肯松口。
lines.en: I shake my head and hold on.

lines.zh: 一口没咬中，我打个转再来。
lines.en: I miss, spin, and try again.

lines.zh: 细腿踹在它膝弯上。
lines.en: My thin leg kicks the back of its knee.

lines.zh: 我用头顶它，把它撞歪。
lines.en: I butt it and knock it off balance.

lines.zh: 牙齿磕在一起，声音很脆。
lines.en: My teeth click together, sharp and dry.

lines.zh: 它抬手挡，我改咬手腕。
lines.en: It raises a guard, so I bite the wrist.

lines.zh: 我撕下一小块，退开咀嚼。
lines.en: I tear off a scrap and back away chewing.

lines.zh: 追到这一步，我就不会放。
lines.en: Having chased this far, I won't let go.

lines.zh: 我从土里站起来，抖落一身尘。
lines.en: I rise from the soil and shake off the dust.

lines.zh: 一声长鸣划开平原的静。
lines.en: A long cry splits the quiet of the plain.

lines.zh: 我第一次看见这片草原，好亮。
lines.en: First look at this grassland — so bright.

lines.zh: 腿还发软，我先站稳。
lines.en: My legs are weak; I steady myself first.

lines.zh: 风穿过肋骨，我知道自己活了。
lines.en: Wind threads my ribs; I know I'm alive.

lines.zh: 远处的蕨丛在动，我记下了。
lines.en: Ferns stir in the distance; I note it.

lines.zh: 我抬起长尾，试着摆一摆。
lines.en: I lift my long tail and try a swing.

lines.zh: 泥土的气味灌进肺里。
lines.en: The smell of wet earth fills my lungs.

lines.zh: 四下一片陌生，我先走一圈。
lines.en: All is strange; I'll walk one circle.

lines.zh: 影子落在我脚前，这是我第一个脚印。
lines.en: A shadow lies before me — my first footprint.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，喉咙还很干。
lines.en: I open my jaws; my throat is still dry.

lines.zh: 这座平原从今天起归我看守。
lines.en: This plain is mine to watch from today.

lines.zh: 火燎到羽毛，我乱窜着扑打。
lines.en: Flame catches my down and I bolt, beating at it.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，骨头在响。
lines.en: I fall from a height and my bones rattle.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我拼命蹬腿。
lines.en: Water floods my throat; I kick desperately.

lines.zh: 轰的一声，我被掀翻在地。
lines.en: A blast flips me onto my side.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进来，我扭头去咬。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in me; I twist to bite it.

lines.zh: 那股紫光一触，我浑身发麻。
lines.en: That violet light touches me and I go numb.

lines.zh: 肚子空得贴背，我站不稳。
lines.en: My belly is empty to the spine; I can't stand straight.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的鳞片全竖了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and every scale stands up.

lines.zh: 地没了，我的长尾在空里乱摆。
lines.en: The ground is gone and my long tail thrashes in nothing.
